summary: Sino Green Land Corp. (OTC: SGLA) entered a stock purchase agreement to acquire 80% of Hi-Quality Productions Inc., a New Jersey corporation, from seller Cheng You. Total consideration is US$1.8 million, payable 30% cash (US$540,000) and 70% in SGLA common stock valued at a fixed US$0.60 per share, issued in three tranches at closing, six and twelve months. An earn-out tied to FY2026 audited net income can raise total consideration to US$1.98 million. No board recommendation or advisor was disclosed. Watch for share overhang from stock tranches and earn-out performance risk.
